doc.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023

title: Closing compliments and hope for a part two
summary: Wilson praises Rowe's career and both agree to a second interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yes. Gee I read all the information on you when I heard we were going to be doing this, and your career actually is interesting ‘cause boy, you’re everywhere, you know in composition, classical so-called, but it’s all music as far as I’m concerned, period. Right? Yeah I knew that.
Well this has been marvelous. I know we could go on for a couple of more hours and maybe we’ll look down the road for a part 2.
